understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, while avoiding spike tiles and completing the game within the available attempts and turns.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally when possible, while gravity moves the player downward through open spaces. Clicking a clickable tile can remove it and may let the player fall or move through that area; unsuccessful clicks consume a turn or may do nothing. Landing on spikes ends the attempt, and failed attempts restart the level. Undo behavior was not directly observed.
